post: We open-sourced the internal tool we built to automate part of our AI workflow.
reference_comment: W builders

post: We're giving our AI agents more tools and more autonomy. The main question is how much autonomy they should have before asking a human.
reference_comment: The hard part is defining the stopping condition, not adding another tool.

post: Our evaluation pipeline now scores every agent run automatically, but some technically correct outputs are still useless to the user.
reference_comment: I wonder whether the benchmark should separate failure modes instead of collapsing them into one score.

post: We improved our agent by adding much more memory across tasks.
reference_comment: More memory isn't necessarily better. Lifetime and deletion are part of the system boundary too.

post: Our document parser improved its average benchmark score by 12%, but scanned pages, forms, tables and charts behave very differently.
reference_comment: Did the gain come from routing by page class or from the parser inside each route?

post: We added another graph layer to our multi-agent workflow to make the architecture easier to reason about.
reference_comment: What survives a restart is a more useful question than how many nodes are in the graph.

post: Companies are preparing for new AI transparency requirements, but most still don't know where AI is actually being used.
reference_comment: Who can stop it is the operational question I'd put next to where AI is used.

post: Our AI system now routes difficult cases to a human reviewer before completing an action.
reference_comment: The human isn't just a fallback here. They define the stopping condition.
style_note: Defines the role of human authority.

post: We reduced the permissions available to each AI agent so failures stay contained.
reference_comment: Minimum access is useful, but the recovery path matters just as much.

post: The first version of our AI product looked great in the demo. Production exposed most of the real engineering work.
reference_comment: The happy path tells you very little about recovery.

post: We're comparing agent traces across several versions of the system to find where quality improved.
reference_comment: I wonder whether the right unit of evaluation is the decision, not the trace.
